done_when: A Claude worker's fix round continues the session its first round started and gets only the short fix prompt; when that session can't be continued it starts fresh with the full brief and says so; tests run forge work twice on a Claude worker and check both paths

findings.body: Client user-facing tasks and prototype fixes use the design Claude route. This line excludes that route from session recovery, and `worker.py:124` still calls `_run` without a session flag. A second `forge work` therefore starts a new Claude session with the full brief. The design-route command test at `tests/test_design_route.py:15` does not assert continuity.

findings.body: The new continuity test configures `repo = "forge-source"`, which cannot enter the design Claude route. The existing design-route test checks worker selection but not two rounds of the same item. A command-level test must assert that the second design round resumes the first session and receives the short prompt; it would fail with the current route.
findings.title: Not done: a two-round forge work test for a design Claude worker

findings.body: The session record is local to `.git/forge`. If it is absent after a first round, the committed item state still shows prior work, but `worker.py:92` sets `session` to `None` and retains `fresh = "first turn"`. `_claude` sends the full brief without saying that it restarted. This test deletes only the stub's Claude session store, leaving Forge's record intact, so it cannot catch that failure.
findings.title: Not done: a forge work fallback test when the local Claude record is missing

findings.body: The fallback recognizes only output beginning `No conversation found`. Claude also documents transcript-read failures from `claude -p --resume`, including `Failed to resume session: EBADF`, which exit with code 1 ([error reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/errors)). For those failures `_run` refuses the round instead of starting fresh with the full brief and an explanation. The stub and new test exercise only the one recognized message; they need a command-level case for a different unrecoverable resume error.
findings.title: Not done: a fallback test for other documented Claude resume failures

findings.body: After a failed resume on round 2, this creates a replacement record with `rounds: 0`. The completed round raises it to 1, so the next `forge work` labels round 3 as `Fix round 2` again. Keep the item's count when replacing its session so subsequent prompts describe the actual round.
findings.title: Preserve fix-round numbering after replacing a Claude session

why: Claude workers start a fresh session every round and get the whole brief again, so fix rounds lose the worker's context, unlike Codex workers
